svg.title: Search, filter and sort answer different questions
svg.desc: Synthetic records: R1 art 0.4; R2 science 0.9; R3 art 0.7; Search first art: compare R1 → match → stop (1 comparison); Filter art: inspect R1, R2, R3 → retain R1 and R3 (3 comparisons); Sort all by score, descending: R2, R3, R1; One adjacent-swap pass may leave a partly sorted list. Repeat to finish.
svg.text: Search, filter and sort answer different questions
Synthetic records: R1 art 0.4; R2 science 0.9; R3 art 0.7
Search first art: compare R1 → match → stop (1 comparison)
Filter art: inspect R1, R2, R3 → retain R1 and R3 (3 comparisons)
Sort all by score, descending: R2, R3, R1
One adjacent-swap pass may leave a partly sorted list. Repeat to finish.
